title: Choosing the compute: request profile, cost model and effort to migrate

videos.script: Every option in this course runs your code. This lesson is about choosing one with numbers rather than with reputation. {{profile}} First, the traffic. Write it down as requests per second, hour by hour, for an ordinary day. Twenty-four numbers say more than any opinion about a platform. {{model}} Then the price. A short program reads the price sheet from lesson 1 and prices the same service four ways. The answer changes with the shape of the traffic. A quiet webhook belongs on Cloud Run billed by request. A busy API outgrows it. {{effort}} Then the work. State on a local disk, a request longer than an hour, a protocol that is not HTTP. Each one rules options out before any price is read. {{choice}} Last, the shop itself. Four services, four answers, and a table that says when to look again.
